items.question: Which categories of living beings are included in the scope of the directional oblation?
premises: The verse enumerates humans, wild animals, horses, cattle, and birds.
The particle vā introduces reptiles as an alternative or additional category.
The listed beings form a broad range of living creatures.
items.inference: The directional oblation encompasses a wide range of living beings, from humans to reptiles.
uncertainties: The exact ritual role of these beings in relation to the diśā-homam is not specified in this verse alone.
items.plain_english: Humans, wild animals, horses, cattle, birds, or reptiles.
